audit_findings.Observed_Bias: Uniform L2 shrinkage (0.1*N) on overcomplete bases + uncentered mean offset
audit_findings.Impact_on_Sparse_vs_Dense: Severely suppresses high-D sparse SAE/topics relative to low-D dense PCA
audit_findings.Required_Mathematical_Fix: Normalize Ridge penalty by dimension: lambda = (0.1*N)/D or use ElasticNet/kNN

audit_findings.Observed_Bias: Standardizing rare-cell indicators (std=sqrt(p)) inflates difference variance by 1/p
audit_findings.Impact_on_Sparse_vs_Dense: Artificially inflates Dirichlet energy and distorts Moran's I on sparse topics
audit_findings.Required_Mathematical_Fix: Use scale-free Cosine Laplacian Energy or non-standardized robust variation

audit_findings.Observed_Bias: Divides eRank by total dimension D (Normalized_eRank = eRank / D)
audit_findings.Impact_on_Sparse_vs_Dense: Penalizes overcomplete dictionaries (D=256) despite higher true signal rank
audit_findings.Required_Mathematical_Fix: Evaluate raw eRank or normalize against ground truth lineage count (eRank / K_gt)

audit_findings.Observed_Bias: Gaussian MSE R² on >90% dropout + raw variance HVG selection
audit_findings.Impact_on_Sparse_vs_Dense: Rewards trivial zero-predicting baselines; only reconstructs high-mean housekeepers
audit_findings.Required_Mathematical_Fix: Standardized VMR gene selection + Poisson/NB Deviance Explained + Cosine Sim

audit_findings.Observed_Bias: Heuristic multiplication compounding biased intermediate terms
audit_findings.Impact_on_Sparse_vs_Dense: Distorts overall rankings by compounding eRank/D and MSE R² penalties
audit_findings.Required_Mathematical_Fix: Harmonized geometric mean across orthogonal, unbiased dimensions
